nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

**Convert Image Color Space** ACEScct → `HDR` (Rec.2020 HLG) feeds the video; the ACEScct image goes to the EXR save.

nodes.title: Save video
widgets_values:
## Save HDR

1. **Save EXR (ACEScg)** — `LTXVHDRDecodePostprocess` with `save_exr` on and `exr_color_space` = `acescg`; writes the ACEScg EXR sequence to `output/hdr_exr`. Its image outputs are not used.
2. **HLG video**: Create Video (`HDR`, generated audio) → Save Video (10-bit; auto = H.264, AV1 also available). Core HLG uses 1.0 = 203 nits and clips above 1000 nits.

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs (native HDR → HDR)

Load an **EXR still** (`Load EXR still`). Set **fps** and **duration**; Source HDR repeats the plate to `1 + floor(fps × duration / 8) × 8` frames.

This is **not** the SDR→HDR IC-LoRA upgrade. Frames stay in ACEScct; the video VAE is forced to float32 inside **Load Models** (`VAE float32`); `img_compression` is 0. The example IC-LoRA is the **detail refiner** (`ltx25_general_refine.safetensors`).

Size combos (`tile_size`, `initial_canvas_size`, `output_size`) are widgets on **Preprocess**.

### Stage 1 prompt

Describe the **change** you want on the HDR plate.

The negative prompt is used as written. Enable **Enhance positive prompt** or paste an **LTX API key** to encode through the API.

### Stage 2 prompt

This pass uses spatial tiling. Describe **look and style** only: lighting, palette, film stock, sharpness, grade. Do **not** name specific objects, people, or props — anything you name can stamp into every spatial tile after upscale.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- Video VAE — `ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors`

- [ Text encoder - gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors)

Same two-stage tiled ladder as Dynamic / SDR→HDR, but native HDR I/O (EXR still → ACEScct, float32 VAE) and the **detail refiner** (`ltx25_general_refine.safetensors`) instead of the HDR IC-LoRA. After decode: EXR + HLG.

Put LoRAs in `ComfyUI/models/loras/`.

## Generate — stage 1

**Tiled Fusion Sampler**, 8 distilled steps with the refine IC-LoRA. Tile equals the FullHD canvas when `tile_size` matches. `SAMPLER` is euler. Sigmas must end at 0.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

**Get Tiling Sizes** and canvas resize live in this subgraph. `tile_size` / `initial_canvas_size` are qHD / HD / FullHD; `output_size` is FullHD / 4K / 8K. Stage 1 guide at the initial canvas. `LTXVPreprocess` uses **img_compression = 0** (JPEG/CRF on ACEScct darkens highlights). `use_streaming` is on; `use_tiled_encode` stays **false**. Audio is an empty latent (native HDR I2V setup), not frozen from a soundtrack.
